company.name: OneChronos
company.shortDescription: The Smart Market for Institutional Investors
company.description:
OneChronos is a Smart Market, which is a technical name for marketplaces that use mathematical optimization to match counterparties. Smart markets have a track record of outperforming traditional markets in terms of price improvement, liquidity, trade size, and fairness.

Smart Markets enable Expressive Bidding, a technology that combines the authenticity of voice trading with the benefits of an electronic venue. The unique liquidity generated by Expressive Bidding can benefit all market participants.

OneChronos was established on July 1, 2015 in New York, United States.
